Date March 29, 1934.
Date 29 / 3 / 34

Subject (in full) S.A. Salunin alias Zabounin, Soviet Employee.

Made by D.S. Tcheremshansky Forwarded by [Signature]

Sergey Alex Salunin alias Zabounin, a new employee of
Centrosojus, arrived at Shanghai from Moscow via Kobe, Japan,
on March 9, 1934 accompanied by his wife and two daughters.
Salunin is a Russian, 36 years of age. He holds U.S.S.R.
passport No.119443/23531 issued in December, 1933 at Moscow.
His wife, Matilda Salunin, is 34 years of age and holds U.S.S.R.
passport No.119444/23532 issued in December, 1933 at Moscow.
They have two daughters: Lidia 7 years of age and Valentina
5 years of age. It is reported that Salunin will be appointed
Chief Bookkeeper of the local office of Centrosojus to replace
N.I. Krassovsky who was recently discharged. Salunin travelled
to Shanghai in company with one E.S. Ginsbourg, also an employee
of Centrosojus.

Salunin at first stayed in the New Asia Hotel, North
Szechuen Road and Tienlong Road corner but on March 15, 1934
he removed to the boarding house of Mrs. M. Pasche, Nos.133-135
Lane 591 Bubbling Well Road.

[Signature]
D. S.
Deputy Commissioner,
Special Branch.

（左侧批注：* See D 5767）
（左下角手写批注：file / m）

事由（全称） S.A. Salunin，又名 Zabounin，苏联雇员。

呈报人 D.S. Tcheremshansky 转呈人 [签名]

Sergey Alex Salunin，又名 Zabounin，系中央消费合作总社（Centrosojus）新聘雇员，于1934年3月9日由其妻及两女陪同，经日本神户从莫斯科抵达上海。Salunin 系俄罗斯人，现年36岁。持有1933年12月在莫斯科签发的苏联护照，号码为119443/23531。其妻 Matilda Salunin，现年34岁，持有1933年12月在莫斯科签发的苏联护照，号码为119444/23532。她们育有两女：Lidia，7岁；Valentina，5岁。据报，Salunin 将被任命为中央消费合作总社本地办事处首席簿记员，以接替近期被解职的 N.I. Krassovsky。Salunin 系与同为中央消费合作总社雇员的 E.S. Ginsbourg 一同旅沪。

Salunin 初住于北四川路与天隆路转角的新亚酒店，但于1934年3月15日迁至静安寺路591弄133-135号 M. Pasche 太太经营的寄宿舍。

[签名]
D. S.
副督察长，
特别科。

（左侧批注：* 见 D 5767）
（左下角手写批注：归档 / m）
